approved_values.case_example_policy: N-of-1 case study examples must link to the canonical HandicapSkater.com evidence route.
approved_values.declaration: N-of-1 evidence model. Wearable signals estimate physiologic, MSK, movement, and transport burden; source artifacts and validation layers remain available for audit.
review_principles: Keep functional output beside observed burden.
Keep sample counts, units, missingness, and limitations visible.
Distinguish a case-study example from a generalized conclusion.

limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
plain_language_finding: An individualized result illustrates a review method; it does not establish a universal standard.
source_labels: Canonical scientific quality and coverage views
summary: Review functional output, observed burden, sample scope, quality, and limitations together.
title: How to review individualized evidence
